Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Dartmouth Office of the President page and incorrectly stated that Nathan Lord (Henry C. Lord’s father) graduated from Dartmouth College, conflating his role/honorary D.D. (1828) with alma mater. The page actually says he was a graduate of Bowdoin College.
